name: Aurelian-Giant
description: Aurelian-Giant hangs in a binary sky like a gilded coin, its cloud bands streaked gold and deep amber beneath the doubled light of two suns. A single storm—the Gilded Eye—circles the entire planet every nine days, dragging a spiral tail of lightning storms behind it that can be seen from neighboring systems. Its debris ring catches both sunrises at once and burns white.

There is nowhere to stand; descent probes dissolve into the ammonia haze at depth, and the toxic atmosphere strips breathing gear seals within hours. What the giant offers instead is concealment: radar-eating haze layers, gravity wells that scatter pursuit trajectories, and ring shadows deep enough to hide a battlefleet.

Which is precisely how the Kestrel Flotilla uses it. Somewhere in the upper cloud bands drifts a hideout rigged from a captured ore-barge, home to perhaps two hundred pirates who strike the helium-3 lanes and vanish into the storm tail. Rumor places a pre-Imperial smuggler cache among the ring's largest moonlets—antimatter containment bottles from a war nobody officially fought, still cold and still full.

Two navies have mounted cleanup operations into the cloud decks; neither has come back with prisoners, or much of anything else. The bounty on the Flotilla's leadership doubles yearly, and the cache, if it exists, would fund a small war. Every smuggler in the sector knows the coordinates by heart and none will say them aloud above a whisper.
